nl.title: Rewrite rules en .htaccess-gedrag onder OpenLiteSpeed in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: Rewrite rules en .htaccess-gedrag onder OpenLiteSpeed in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
OpenLiteSpeed leest veel .htaccess-rewrite regels, maar niet alles 1-op-1 zoals Apache. Test permalinks en custom redirects na wijzigingen.

Praktijk

  • WordPress-permalinks: sla opnieuw op onder Instellingen → Permalinks.
  • Complexere Apache-only directives kunnen in OLS context/rewrite horen.
  • Redirects liever centraal (CyberPanel redirect) dan rommelige htaccess-stapels.

Debug

  1. Reproduceer 404 vs redirect-loop.
  2. Bekijk error-log van de vhost.
  3. Tijdelijk vereenvoudig .htaccess om de boosdoener te vinden.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Logs; OLS herstarten; domein redirects.

en.title: Rewrite rules and .htaccess-gedrag onder OpenLiteSpeed in CyberPanel
en.excerpt: CyberPanel: select website, correct module (SSL/DNS/Email/Files/Backup), purge OLS cache.
en.bodyHtml:
In CyberPanel select the website first. For “Rewrite rules and .htaccess-gedrag onder OpenLiteSpeed in CyberPanel” then open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — depending on the task.

Preparation

  • CyberPanel URL + login
  • Domain name

Steps

  1. Sign in to CyberPanel (port 8090 or welcome link).
  2. Go to Websites and open the correct domain.
  3. Choose the module: SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager, Databases or Backup.
  4. Apply the change and save.
  5. Purge OpenLiteSpeed cache if the site shows old content.
  6. On 500/white screen: open Error Logs for that website.

Verify

  • Change visible on the live URL
  • No new errors in the logs

Tip: Note old DNS/SSL values before you save.

Note: Selecting the wrong website changes another site’s production.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel login, SSL, OLS cache.
